docs.title: Welcome to My Academic Site
docs.text:
Welcome! I'm Dr. Ifeanyi Oguamah, a Senior Lecturer at the Department of Petroleum Engineering, Federal University of Technology, Owerri (FUTO).

This website provides my lecture notes, publications, and research projects on: - Reservoir Engineering - Asphaltene Molecular Dynamics Simulation - Gas-to-Liquids Technology - Environmentally Friendly Flow Assurance Methods

If you have difficulty accessing the files, email: 📧 ifeanyi.oguamah@futo.edu.ng
